Lina (Marketing): Hey team — planning to publish the launch post T-24. Need canonical docs URL + bench blurb. Arjun, quick status on changelog and perf?
Arjun (Engineering): Changelog PR#1012 ready. Perf run finishing; should have public-safe summary in ~2h.
Maya (Product): Marketing wants non-PR docs link. Can DevEx stage /docs/releases/2026-03-ignite?
Kai (DevEx): Staging build started. Will push to staging URL and then flip to prod when signoff.
deploy-bot: docs staging deploy started (job id: doc-3311).
Kai (DevEx): Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-ignite — will promote to prod after Arjun merges.
Lina (Marketing): Benchmark language proposal: "~2x throughput improvement on common gen workloads (see benchmark notes)". We'll link sanitized bench page.
Arjun (Engineering): I'll sanitize and publish: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-ignite. Merging once tests green.
Maya (Product): Webinar scheduled Apr 10. Marketing needs HubSpot tag "launch-2026-03" and nurture list "ignite-webinar". Kai, can you add webhook?
Kai (DevEx): Yup — adding webhook scoped to landing_page_id so only registrants get the tag.
Lina (Marketing): Go checklist: 1) Merge changelog 2) Prod docs URL live 3) Public bench link 4) Post scheduled 5) HubSpot webhook. React when done.
Arjun (Engineering): Merged PR#1012 and kicked release pipeline (1723456500). :white_check_mark:
Kai (DevEx): Prod docs published: https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-ignite — CDN warming. :white_check_mark:
Arjun (Engineering): Public bench page live: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-ignite-summary. Use conservative wording.
Lina (Marketing): Perfect. Scheduling post now. Ping here if anything changes.
